title: त्रिपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: The Pandavas enter the city and rest, and in the last watch of the night Krishna rises and sends Satyaki to bring Yudhishthira's chariots. Krishna and the Pandavas, with Vyasa and the sages, go to Kurukshetra and find Bhishma like the sun fallen to earth.
summary.kn: ಪಾಂಡವರು ನಗರ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಿ ವಿಶ್ರಮಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ; ರಾತ್ರಿಯ ಕೊನೆ ಯಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಎದ್ದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನ ರಥಗಳನ್ನು ತರಲು ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿಯನ್ನು ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕೃಷ್ಣ, ಪಾಂಡವರು, ವ್ಯಾಸ, ಋಷಿಗಳು ಕುರುಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಭೂಮಿಗೆ ಬಿದ್ದ ಸೂರ್ಯನಂತಿರುವ ಭೀಷ್ಮನನ್ನು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: पाण्डव नगर में प्रवेश कर विश्राम करते हैं, और रात्रि के अन्तिम पहर में कृष्ण उठकर सात्यकि को युधिष्ठिर के रथ लाने भेजते हैं। कृष्ण और पाण्डव व्यास तथा ऋषियों के साथ कुरुक्षेत्र जाकर पृथ्वी पर गिरे सूर्य जैसे भीष्म को देखते हैं।
summary.te: పాండవులు నగరంలో ప్రవేశించి విశ్రమిస్తారు; రాత్రి చివరి యామంలో కృష్ణుడు లేచి యుధిష్ఠిరుని రథాలు తేవడానికి సాత్యకిని పంపుతాడు. కృష్ణుడు, పాండవులు, వ్యాసుడు, ఋషులతో కురుక్షేత్రానికి వెళ్లి నేలపై పడిన సూర్యునిలా ఉన్న భీష్ముని చూస్తారు.
summary.ta: பாண்டவர் நகரில் புகுந்து ஓய்வெடுக்க, இரவின் இறுதிச் சாமத்தில் கண்ணன் எழுந்து யுதிஷ்டிரரின் தேர்களைக் கொணர சாத்யகியை அனுப்புகிறார். கண்ணன், பாண்டவர், வியாசர், முனிவருடன் குருக்ஷேத்திரம் சென்று தரையில் விழுந்த சூரியன் போன்ற பீஷ்மரைக் காண்கின்றனர்.
summary.ml: പാണ്ഡവർ നഗരത്തിൽ പ്രവേശിച്ച് വിശ്രമിക്കുന്നു; രാത്രിയുടെ അവസാന യാമത്തിൽ കൃഷ്ണൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റ് യുധിഷ്ഠിരന്റെ രഥങ്ങൾ കൊണ്ടുവരാൻ സാത്യകിയെ അയയ്ക്കുന്നു. കൃഷ്ണനും പാണ്ഡവരും വ്യാസനും മുനിമാരും ചേർന്ന് കുരുക്ഷേത്രത്തിലെത്തുന്നു; ഭൂമിയിൽ വീണ സൂര്യനെപ്പോലെ ഭീഷ്മരെ അവർ കാണുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.53; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततः प्रविश्य भवनं प्रसुप्तो मधुसूदनः ।
याममात्रावशेषायां यामिन्यां प्रत्यबुध्यत ॥

meaning.en: Then Madhusudana entered his house and slept, and woke when only one watch of the night remained.

verses.text:
स ध्यानपथमाश्रित्य सर्वज्ञानानि माधवः ।
अवलोक्य ततः पश्चाद्दध्यौ ब्रह्म सनातनम् ॥

meaning.en: Taking the path of meditation, Madhava reviewed all branches of knowledge, and afterwards meditated on the eternal Brahman.

verses.text:
ततः श्रुतिपुराणज्ञाः शिक्षिता रक्तकण्ठिनः ।
अस्तुवन्विश्वकर्माणं वासुदेवं प्रजापतिम् ॥

meaning.en: Then reciters learned in the Vedas and Puranas, trained and red-throated, praised Vasudeva as maker of the universe and lord of creatures.

verses.text:
पठन्ति पाणिस्वनिकास्तथा गायन्ति गायनाः ।
शङ्खानकमृदङ्गांश्च प्रवाद्यन्त सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Clappers chanted, singers sang, and conches, kettledrums and mridangas were sounded by the thousand.

verses.text:
वीणापणववेणूनां स्वनश्चातिमनोरमः ।
प्रहास इव विस्तीर्णः शुश्रुवे तस्य वेश्मनः ॥

meaning.en: The delightful sound of lutes, drums and flutes was heard from his house, spreading wide like a burst of laughter.

verses.text:
तथा युधिष्ठिरस्यापि राज्ञो मङ्गलसंहिताः ।
उच्चेरुर्मधुरा वाचो गीतवादित्रसंहिताः ॥

meaning.en: Likewise for King Yudhishthira, sweet auspicious words rose up, mingled with song and instruments.

verses.text:
तत उत्थाय दाशार्हः स्नातः प्राञ्जलिरच्युतः ।
जप्त्वा गुह्यं महाबाहुरग्नीनाश्रित्य तस्थिवान् ॥

meaning.en: Then Dasharha, the mighty-armed Achyuta, rose, bathed, joined his palms, murmured the secret prayer and stood by the sacred fires.

verses.text:
ततः सहस्रं विप्राणां चतुर्वेदविदां तथा ।
गवां सहस्रेणैकैकं वाचयामास माधवः ॥

meaning.en: Then Madhava had a thousand brahmins learned in the four Vedas recite blessings, giving each of them a thousand cows.

verses.text:
मङ्गलालम्भनं कृत्वा आत्मानमवलोक्य च ।
आदर्शे विमले कृष्णस्ततः सात्यकिमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Having touched auspicious things and looked at himself in a clear mirror, Krishna then spoke to Satyaki.

verses.text:
गच्छ शैनेय जानीहि गत्वा राजनिवेशनम् ।
अपि सज्जो महातेजा भीष्मं द्रष्टुं युथिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: Go, descendant of Shini, to the king's residence and find out whether the greatly radiant Yudhishthira is ready to see Bhishma.

verses.text:
ततः कृष्णस्य वचनात्सात्यकिस्त्वरितो ययौ ।
उपगम्य च राजानं युधिष्ठिरमुवाच ह ॥

meaning.en: Then at Krishna's word Satyaki went quickly, and reaching King Yudhishthira he spoke.

verses.text:
युक्तो रथवरो राजन्वासुदेवस्य धीमतः ।
समीपमापगेयस्य प्रयास्यति जनार्दनः ॥

meaning.en: Wise Vasudeva's fine chariot is yoked, king; Janardana will go to the son of the river-goddess.

verses.text:
भवत्प्रतीक्षः कृष्णोऽसौ धर्मराज महाद्युते ।
यदत्रानन्तरं कृत्यं तद्भवान्कर्तुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: Krishna is waiting for you, king of dharma, of great radiance; you should do what must be done next.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
युज्यतां मे रथवरः फल्गुनाप्रतिमद्युते ।
न सैनिकैश्च यातव्यं यास्यामो वयमेव हि ॥

meaning.en: Let my best chariot be yoked, Phalguna, whose splendor has no equal; the troops must not come along, for we shall go by ourselves.

verses.text:
न च पीडयितव्यो मे भीष्मो धर्मभृतां वरः ।
अतः पुरःसराश्चापि निवर्तन्तु धनंजय ॥

meaning.en: Bhishma, best of the upholders of dharma, must not be troubled; so let even the escorts who go before turn back, Dhananjaya.

verses.text:
अद्यप्रभृति गाङ्गेयः परं गुह्यं प्रवक्ष्यति ।
ततो नेच्छामि कौन्तेय पृथग्जनसमागमम् ॥

meaning.en: From today Ganga's son will speak of the highest secrets, so, son of Kunti, I do not want a crowd of common people to gather.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
तद्वाक्यमाकर्ण्य तथा कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः ।
युक्तं रथवरं तस्मा आचचक्षे नरर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Hearing those words, Dhananjaya, son of Kunti, told him that the best chariot was ready, bull among men.

verses.text:
ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा यमौ भीमार्जुनावपि ।
भूतानीव समस्तानि ययुः कृष्णनिवेशनम् ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira, the twins, Bhima and Arjuna went to Krishna's residence, like all beings together.

verses.text:
आगच्छत्स्वथ कृष्णोऽपि पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु ।
शैनेयसहितो धीमान्रथमेवान्वपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: When the great-souled Pandavas arrived, wise Krishna too, with Satyaki, mounted his own chariot.

verses.text:
रथस्थाः संविदं कृत्वा सुखां पृष्ट्वा च शर्वरीम् ।
मेघघोषै रथवरैः प्रययुस्ते महारथाः ॥

meaning.en: Seated in their chariots, having agreed together and asked after one another's night, those great warriors set out in chariots rumbling like thunderclouds.

verses.text:
मेघपुष्पं बलाहं च सैन्यं सुग्रीवमेव च ।
दारुकश्चोदयामास वासुदेवस्य वाजिनः ॥

meaning.en: Daruka urged on Vasudeva's horses, Meghapushpa, Balahaka, Shaibya and Sugriva.

verses.text:
ते हया वासुदेवस्य दारुकेण प्रचोदिताः ।
गां खुराग्रैस्तथा राजँल्लिखन्तः प्रययुस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Driven by Daruka, Vasudeva's horses went on, king, scoring the earth with the tips of their hooves.

verses.text:
ते ग्रसन्त इवाकाशं वेगवन्तो महाबलाः ।
क्षेत्रं धर्मस्य कृत्स्नस्य कुरुक्षेत्रमवातरन् ॥

meaning.en: Swift and mighty, as though swallowing the sky, they came down to Kurukshetra, the field of all dharma.

verses.text:
ततो ययुर्यत्र भीष्मः शरतल्पगतः प्रभुः ।
आस्ते ब्रह्मर्षिभिः सार्धं ब्रह्मा देवगणैर्यथा ॥

meaning.en: Then they went to where the lord Bhishma lay on his bed of arrows, seated with the brahmin sages like Brahma among the hosts of gods.

verses.text:
ततोऽवतीर्य गोविन्दो रथात्स च युधिष्ठिरः ।
भीमो गाण्डीवधन्वा च यमौ सात्यकिरेव च ।
ऋषीनभ्यर्चयामासुः करानुद्यम्य दक्षिणान् ॥

meaning.en: Then Govinda and Yudhishthira got down from their chariots, as did Bhima, the wielder of Gandiva, the twins and Satyaki, and with right hands raised they saluted the sages.

verses.text:
स तैः परिवृतो राजा नक्षत्रैरिव चन्द्रमाः ।
अभ्याजगाम गाङ्गेयं ब्रह्माणमिव वासवः ॥

meaning.en: Surrounded by them like the moon by stars, the king approached Ganga's son as Indra approaches Brahma.

verses.text:
शरतल्पे शयानं तमादित्यं पतितं यथा ।
ददर्श स महाबाहुर्भयादागतसाध्वसः ॥

meaning.en: The mighty-armed king saw him lying on his bed of arrows like a fallen sun, and his heart was seized with fear.
